integrity: The infinite formulas are proved symbolically from the published profile characterization and the classical Sparre--Andersen factorization. The finite checker is supplementary and is not used as proof of the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The result counts distinct exponent-profile vectors, not matrices or factor orders.
Only the even-order asymptotic constant is claimed; odd orders are covered exactly by the recurrence but not asymptotically.
The profile characterization itself is an input from arXiv:2609.35846v1; the new content is the walk enumeration, generating function, and even-order asymptotic.
title: Exact walk enumeration and even-order asymptotics for basic oscillatory exponent profiles
